story.review_method: Read complete original and complete revision, compare changed paragraphs and preserved incident sequence. Prose review only; no illustration clearance.

observations: Independent reviewer opened all three current sheets at native resolution, originals and native detail crops; no material findings. Qualitative scale and grooming states remain provisional.

Four Neet feet on flat belt slats with connected trunk, four Buddy feet on separate stationary tile floor; carousel edge and clear pickup gap distinguish elevation. Suitcase behind Neet supports luggage joke. Provisional cropped reaching human hand is separate from dog.

Final must shorten tufted Neet nub to near-flush rounded stub, close Neet throat and Buddy foreleg/underside contours while keeping face/ear furnishing. Actual staging is substantially colored, still reviewed as drawn staging, not final.
Every current finished image opened at full resolution against original photos; concrete findings recorded per image.

inspection.inspection: Read full accessibility text, then traversed entire rendered document in overlapping 0.65–0.8-page scrolls with screenshots from title through final provenance bullet. Inspected all three embedded images at intended reading size with adjacent text; no raw-Markdown-only acceptance.
inspection.scope: Complete primary, refinement record and all provenance. No meaningful alternate text present; comedy-pass explains the three source encodings differ only in formatting/equivalent prose.

selected_images.placement_after: Neet pressed his little bag behind his forelegs. Buddy looked straight ahead with the fierce concentration of a dog who had never met an olive.
selected_images.alt_text: Neet hides the bag while Buddy concentrates on looking innocent.

selected_images.placement_after: Buddy followed along the stationary edge as Neet rotated like a rotisserie chicken. He stopped at the next clear gap and barked. If Neet insisted on being luggage, someone had to be there to collect him.
selected_images.alt_text: Buddy waits at the clear pickup gap while Neet enjoys becoming part of the baggage.

selected_images.placement_after: He took one careful step away from the bag, then stopped. What if leaving looked suspicious? The beagle kept sniffing. Buddy stayed exactly where he was.
selected_images.alt_text: The detector beagle finds the bag while Buddy freezes one careful step away.
